title: SchedulerChain
description: Envelope schema for a `manage_chain` define. A chain routes a matched Task goal to a fixed step list. Per-step `arguments` are validated separately against each tool's own registered input_schema (services/validation.rs); this envelope covers the routing fields. Matching is plain CONTAINS with `priority` as the only tiebreak. Self-contained (no external $ref — the validator runs with remote resolution disabled).

name.description: MERGE key; defaults to `pattern` when omitted.

pattern.description: Primary goal substring to match. "" defines a default fallback chain.

priority.description: Lower = matched first (default 100; default chain 9999). A broad substring at a low number silently hijacks a specific one.

data_class.description: private (default when absent) = only no_log providers; public also admits free tiers that may train on prompts. A file-level value is stamped onto steps that set none.

evaluation_rubric.description: Overrides the task goal text for the appended evaluator step.

steps.description: ChainStep array. Enqueued after goal_to_steps routing; may carry evaluator/adversarial/required_capabilities fields.

arguments.description: Validated against the named tool's own input_schema at the write boundary.

provider_hint.description: Top-level sibling of tool_name/arguments. `ollama` = local; omission routes to the active cloud model.

data_class.description: private (default when absent) = only no_log providers; public also admits free tiers that may train on prompts. A file-level value is stamped onto steps that set none.
